title: Understanding MAE and MSE
text: Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Mean Squared Error (MSE) are both measures of prediction accuracy. However, they have different properties and implications for model parameters.

title: Unique Solutions in Linear Regression
text: In linear regression, the uniqueness of the solution depends on the properties of the data and the error metric used. Consider how MAE and MSE might affect this.

title: Properties of MAE
text: Does MAE always lead to a unique solution for the parameters in linear regression?
choices: No, MAE does not always lead to a unique solution.

hintAnswer: Yes, MSE typically leads to a unique solution when the design matrix is full rank.
title: Properties of MSE
text: Does MSE always lead to a unique solution for the parameters in linear regression?
choices: Yes, MSE typically leads to a unique solution when the design matrix is full rank.
